description:
Welcome to 1706 Phyllis Drive in Copperas Cove, Texas! 

This beautifully remodeled home offers the perfect combination of modern updates, comfort, and convenience.

Situated on a desirable corner lot in Meadow Brook Estates, this move-in-ready property features 3 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, a brand-new roof, and a spacious living room centered around a cozy wood-burning fireplace.

The fully remodeled kitchen includes new cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, a breakfast bar, and a breakfast area. Even better, the refrigerator conveys with the home!

Home Features:
• 3 Bedrooms
• 2 Full Bathrooms
• Listed at $210,000
• Completely Remodeled
• New Roof
• Wood-Burning Fireplace
• New Kitchen Cabinets
• Stainless Steel Appliances
• Refrigerator Conveys
• Breakfast Bar
• Breakfast Area
• Corner Lot
• Mature Trees
• Move-In Ready
